steps.name: Questions (1)
steps.objective: Talk to [Shynic] in "Underground City Tartaros", then find [Elena] in "Coral City".

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Resting well, Goddess's Executioner? ♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well enough. I'll go rest some more. Oh, what's in your hand? A letter?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: A letter for you. The format isn't from Eastland... Is it from another continent?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let me see, and I'll tell you.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: (Shynic inspects the letter from every angle, apparently in no hurry to hand it over.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Who is this person? Why seal it with a heart?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're very curious.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I was bored. So who is it? Hmm?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A historian in Atlantis, a city in Jiendia, who studies her ancestors' past. She's researching a city lost in an ancient undersea explosion.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Coral City... Except it suddenly reappeared near Atlantis.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I helped her there.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Really? Coral City, you said? I feel like I've heard that name...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Am I getting close to death? Ugh, I don't know.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What a chilling joke...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Hehe. Only Shynic, Queen of the Underworld, could make that joke. Keep going. This person sounds interesting...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: She's like an idol in Atlantis. So beautiful that men line up to ask her on dates...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Perhaps because she's a distant descendant of Coral City's people, she can enter the rediscovered city when others can't.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Even the creatures revived as spirits don't attack her. Strange, isn't it?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: You went in, too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well, I have the goddess's protection...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: You're boring. Read the letter and tell me what it says. Come on, come on.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nothing much. Just, 'Please come see me after reading this'...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: What?! I was hoping for something fun.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It can't be helped. I'll be going.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: If anything interesting happens, be sure to tell me. Understood? You know what happens if you don't, right? ♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, yes. Don't worry. I'll find an interesting story.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It's been a while. Back to Coral City. I hope Elena's well.)

steps.name: Questions (2)
steps.objective: Defeat [Stingray Assault Troopers] and [Ocellino] in "Twin Cave" and obtain <Genetic Magic Research Notes> and a <Magic Sea Droplet>. Then report to [Elena] in "Coral City".

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: What's this trembling...? Ah, it's you!

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: It's been a while, adventurer!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, you knew I was coming? You sound like you were waiting...

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: The waves seemed to change when you arrived. Anyway, welcome! It's been so long!

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Since you're here, you must have received my letter?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It said you'd reveal Coral City's secret, so I hurried over. This must be important.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Yes. Very important. So many people asked me to dine or go on dates, but I simply couldn't.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Since discovering this, I truly haven't been able to do anything else.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What happened?

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: I think I've discovered another side of the Coral City I knew. I wasn't certain, so I've been puzzling over it.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: And it's difficult without your help... Thank you so much for coming.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: You came because you hadn't forgotten me, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (How should I answer that...?)

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: You don't have to answer. I'll explain what needs doing.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: This probably concerns Goddess Seres...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Goddess Seres?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll go right away. What do you need?

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: I haven't even finished... Thank you. What I need is...

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Could you find the 'Genetic Magic Research Notes' and a 'Magical Sea Droplet' in Twinkive and bring them here?

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Even as a descendant of Coral City's people, this is as far as I can go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's why you called me.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's fine. I'll be back.

steps.name: Questions (3)
steps.objective: Defeat monsters in the "Dragon Valley" and obtain <Fragments of Memory>. Then report to [Elena] in "Coral City".

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Well done.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I remember bringing you these before.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: You remember. Yes. But somehow, when they left Coral City, they crumbled to powder and became useless.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh... That happened...?

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: So I brought the books and materials from my workshop here instead.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: I've already done some work, so it shouldn't take long to explain the discovery.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Records of ancient Coral City are gradually emerging. But some things remain hidden, as though concealed deliberately.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: There are so many clues, yet they're blocked. As if the memories of that time were locked away...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Did this book lose its memories, too? Or does someone not want us to see them?)

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: I think we need another magical element... Do you know a magical tool we could use?

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Oh, adventurer? That expression says you know something.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well, you mentioned memories, and an item came to mind. But I don't know if it'll help the book I brought you.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Could you help once more, just in case? This may concern Goddess Seres...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll go immediately. You'll be here?

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Of course. I'll stay here and wait.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I'll go fetch what we need.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: They hurry off whenever I mention the goddess. Did something happen...?

steps.name: Questions (4)
steps.objective: Travel through the "World Between Times" to find [Siam].

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: You certainly make your arrival known, adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How?

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: There's a current surrounding Coral City. Whenever you arrive, its flow seems to shift or tremble slightly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really? I can't tell...

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: I'd be curious how someone else feels it. But you're the only person besides me who can enter now...

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Never mind. We have more important things. What did you bring? ♬

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know if it'll work, but could you show me your materials?

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: I don't know what you'll do, but I'm excited!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll simply place this on the materials. Then it should find the answer itself. I can't be sure it'll work...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All I can do is trust and hope...

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: What a mysterious object.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: (You place the Memory Fragment on Elena's materials. After a moment, it glows faintly and seeps into the documents.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think it's done...

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Is it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. Take a look.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: (Elena gathers the materials, scans them, and looks startled.)

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: The hidden contents are gradually appearing. What's this? Oh, never mind.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Ahem... I think I can explain now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Please do.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: These research notes weren't created in ancient Coral City. The theory was developed in Atlantis only a few decades ago.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Do you know what happened in Atlantis?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. They did something wrong. But Coral City is ancient. How could...?

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Exactly. Isn't it strange that someone thousands of years ago possessed this? What if an object from the future crossed time?

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: If the people had such objects, King Ocelino couldn't have been unaware.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: A king who wanted to befriend everyone... An undersea city that vanished when Goddess Seres disappeared...

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: And the ray carrying this was originally an ordinary fish. Somehow, it was enhanced and became a soldier of the king.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: I wish we had another clue... Do you know anyone familiar with this kind of phenomenon?

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Someone who can sense beings beyond time and space, with profound magical knowledge...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Someone comes to mind. Can you wait? It's rather far...

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Of course. I'll examine the materials further while you're gone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Time and space... Siam is probably the only one I can ask about this.)

steps.name: Questions (5)
steps.objective: Defeat [Ixion] in the "Abyss Chamber" and obtain the <Hero's Gold Insignia>. Then report to [Siam].

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Welcome. Thank you for visiting so often.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Siam.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: If you've come to this space, it must be no small matter.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Tell me. What troubles you...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You tell Siam about Coral City.)

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: I understand that Coral City vanished when Goddess Seres disappeared. And that research notes on genetic magic, developed with Atlantean technology, were found there.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: I also understand why the historian finds that strange.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: But suppose the reverse were true... What if Atlantean technology was based on ancient objects?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Both her suggestion and mine are hypotheses. We must keep questioning... Far more inexplicable things happen in this world than people imagine.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: What brought me here, and your work for Iris... All such things.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Elena, was it? If her theory is correct, someone must have intervened.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Someone with tremendous power...

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Now I'm curious. But I cannot leave this place. I'd like your help once more.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What can I do?

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Bring the mage's tool you brought before. I must examine the memories that remained in it, beyond the lingering thoughts.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: A great mage of that land must have such tools. Please...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I'll be back.

steps.name: Questions (6)
steps.objective: Talk to [Siam] in the "World Between Times", then find [Elena] in "Coral City".

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Well done. I'll call forth the memories within it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll wait.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: (Siam nods, takes the mage's tool, and concentrates. His brow gradually furrows and hardens.)

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Perhaps Elena's hypothesis is correct.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Memories within a tool do not lie. A tool belonging to someone powerful inevitably remembers its owner.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: This tool calls its master a hypocrite. With someone's help, he sacrificed people who sought justice and became a hero.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How do you know that...?

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: It remains in the tool. The one who gave the mage power is like me, yet somewhat different.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: From another world, but able to cross time and space. A being with power that great...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Siam's words bring someone's face to mind. The one you met recently at the Divine Tree Lapier...)

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: You seem terribly afraid. It's all right. Tell me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You tell Siam what happened in Adrica.)

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Ah, Goddess... I knew a being from another world threatened this one, but to appear directly...

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Sigh. If you need my help, come anytime. I'll gladly give it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Siam...

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: And... Be measured in what you tell the historian in Coral City. Nothing is certain yet. Say only that it is a possible hypothesis.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will... Thank you. I'll also look for a way to free you from this space.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: The thought alone is enough. Give Iris my regards. Get some proper rest, too. And travel safely.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: You're back?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: You don't look well. Did something happen?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, nothing.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: (That expression looks like a lie. Hopefully it isn't serious.)

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Did you visit the person you thought of? Someone you love, perhaps?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, you and your jokes... Just a mage I know, who offered advice about your discovery.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He suggested a hypothesis in reverse.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What if Atlantean technology had been based on ancient objects...?

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: There was no technology to alter genes in ancient times. Unless divine power caused the changes.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Could there be a being who crosses time and space with godlike power? Even the gods don't seem able to do that...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Elena seems to suspect something. She's clever. But I can't tell her.)

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Then again, unbelievable things happened often in ancient times.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: I'm sorry, adventurer. This is my work, and perhaps I relied on you for an easy answer. Thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right. While visiting him, I asked plenty of things I didn't know. It helped me a great deal, too.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: I'm glad. Travel safely.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Take care, Elena.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Back to Tartaros...)

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: They're definitely hiding something... What could it be? There were other places with strange phenomena besides Coral City.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: A mountain and a desert, wasn't it? Perhaps I'll look into them a little...
